## ASD Essential Eight: User application hardening

Measures web browser hardening, Internet Explorer 11 removal, .NET Framework 3.5 and older elimination, PowerShell 2.0 removal, PowerShell Constrained Language Mode and logging, and Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rule coverage using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Vulnerability Management telemetry.

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) summary:**
- **ML1**: Web browsers block Java from the internet and web advertisements; Internet Explorer 11 disabled/removed; users cannot change browser security settings.
- **ML2**: Office, browsers and PDF readers hardened via ASR rules; .NET Framework 3.5 (including 2.0/3.0) and PowerShell 2.0 disabled/removed; PowerShell Constrained Language Mode and central logging enabled.
- **ML3**: Hardened user application configurations centrally enforced and protected from tampering, with blocked execution events monitored.

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model) and [Microsoft Defender Attack Surface Reduction rules reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/attack-surface-reduction-rules-reference).

parameters.name: DeviceGroup
parameters.label: Device group
parameters.query:
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| distinct GroupName
| order by GroupName asc

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
let kpiAsr = DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ConfigurationSubcategory has 'Attack surface reduction' or ConfigurationId has 'asr'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IsApplicable, IsCompliant) by DeviceId, ConfigurationId
| where IsApplicable == true
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize Metric = 'ASR Rule Compliance % (TVM)', Value = round(100.0 * countif(IsCompliant == true) / max_of(count(), 1), 1);
let kpiDotNet = DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where SoftwareName has_any ('dotnet', '.net_framework', 'net_framework') and SoftwareVersion matches regex '^(2|3)\.'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize Metric = 'Devices with .NET Framework <= 3.5 (ML2)', Value = toreal(dcount(DeviceId));
let kpiIe11 = DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where FileName =~ 'iexplore.exe'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize Metric = 'Internet Explorer 11 Executions (ML1)', Value = toreal(count());
let kpiPsV2 = DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where FileName in~ ('powershell.exe', 'powershell_ise.exe') and ProcessCommandLine matches regex '(?i)(^|\s)-(v|ver|version)\s+2(\.0)?(\s|$)'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize Metric = 'PowerShell 2.0 Executions (ML2)', Value = toreal(count());
union kpiAsr, kpiDotNet, kpiIe11, kpiPsV2
content.title: User application hardening KPI summary

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
let tvmAsr = DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ConfigurationSubcategory has 'Attack surface reduction' or ConfigurationId has 'asr'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IsApplicable, IsCompliant, ConfigurationSubcategory) by DeviceId, ConfigurationId
| where IsApplicable == true
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize CompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == true), NonCompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == false) by ConfigurationId, GroupName
| extend CoveragePct = round(100.0 * CompliantDevices / max_of(CompliantDevices + NonCompliantDevices, 1), 1);
tvmAsr
| order by CoveragePct asc, NonCompliantDevices desc
content.title: Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rule compliance coverage by device group (E8-UAH-ML2-01)

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ActionType startswith 'Asr'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| extend Mode = iff(ActionType endswith 'Blocked', 'Blocked', iff(ActionType endswith 'Audited', 'Audited', 'Other'))
| summarize EventCount = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by ActionType, Mode, GroupName
| order by EventCount desc
| take 100
content.title: ASR runtime events: Blocked versus Audited telemetry

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ConfigurationSubcategory has_any ('Browser', 'Edge', 'Chrome', 'Internet Explorer', 'PowerShell', '.NET', 'Java')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IsApplicable, IsCompliant, ConfigurationCategory, ConfigurationSubcategory) by DeviceId, ConfigurationId
| where IsApplicable == true
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize CompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == true), NonCompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == false) by ConfigurationId, ConfigurationSubcategory, GroupName
| extend CompliancePct = round(100.0 * CompliantDevices / max_of(CompliantDevices + NonCompliantDevices, 1), 1)
| order by CompliancePct asc
content.title: Browser, Java, .NET Framework and PowerShell hardening posture (TVM)

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
let clmReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where RegistryValueName =~ '__PSLockdownPolicy' or RegistryKey has 'PowerShell\\ScriptBlockLogging'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, GroupName, Signal = 'PowerShellPolicyRegistry', Detail = strcat(RegistryKey, ' -> ', RegistryValueName, '=', RegistryValueData);
let psLogging = DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ActionType == 'PowerShellCommand'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize CommandsLogged = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName, GroupName
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, DeviceName, GroupName, Signal = 'PowerShellCommandTelemetry', Detail = strcat('Logged commands: ', tostring(CommandsLogged));
union clmReg, psLogging
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: PowerShell Constrained Language Mode (__PSLockdownPolicy) and logging coverage (E8-UAH-ML2-03)
